plugins.name: awow
plugins.description: Bring the Agentic Way of Working to any repo. The setup-awow prompt connects your issue board and your team's conventions; the delivery prompts and skills then keep the board current as a byproduct of the work.

plugins.name: awow-workflows
plugins.description: The optional workflow bundle for awow: design and planning, meetings and retros, digests, strategy and OKRs, knowledge capture, and styled documents. Installs beside awow; self-contained, and expects a repo configured by awow's setup-awow prompt.
